show.description: A man’s life, marked by betrayal and poverty, changes after an accident gives him the power to foresee deaths, hidden illnesses, antique values, and stock futures. Rising from a delivery boy to a city kingmaker, he makes those who rejected him pay. But he soon learns that every power comes with a terrifying cost.
